question: Estimate the monthly sales of premium notebooks/stationery (Classmate, Camlin, Faber-Castell) in a school-heavy city like Pune.
idealClarificationQuestions: Notebooks + writing instruments + accessories? Yes — branded stationery.
Both school + college + corporate stationery? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Student + working population × stationery spend per month.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Pune students K-12 + college + diploma: ~25 lakh.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average monthly branded stationery spend per buyer: ~₹65 (notebooks, pens, refills, accessories).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Peak month June (academic year start): ~3x average.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Average monthly branded stationery spend per buyer

calculationFlow: Pune students K-12 + college + diploma: ~25 lakh.
Of total, branded stationery buyers: ~70% = ~38 lakh.
Average monthly branded stationery spend per buyer: ~₹65 (notebooks, pens, refills, accessories).
Pune monthly branded stationery market: 38L × ₹65 = ~₹25 Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Peak month June (academic year start): ~3x average.
